checks.result: For REPLACE/STATUS the helper requires original Committed state, retained receipt, current Satisfied goal and typed Terminal/Succeeded serialization. Drift, missing readback, rollback, missing receipt/projection and source Indeterminate remain false.

READ_TOOL, REPLACE_TOOL and STATUS_TOOL are pub(crate) &str constants. notes_action_observer and notes_thread_tool are both cfg(target_os = linux), so the new references have compatible visibility and build gating.

json! serializes the same ActionGoalStateV1 and ActionRuntimeStateV1 types used by original_notes_status, avoiding independently handwritten state/tag strings. Terminal/Succeeded shape agrees with retained original GUI data.

No obvious ownership or type inference issue in the helper or two tests. &String coerces to &str at the runtime call. Fixture revision 8 supports both +/-1 probes without underflow. Mutating original.state only affects negative source-state cases; succeeded is independently retained JSON.

READ's existing successful-read convention is preserved after original navigation refusal checks. Later replace refusal and status unknown remain false. Unknown tool names are now explicitly false; this does not expand the admitted catalog.
Only existing source/test files change. No new module, dependency, include_str/include_bytes or compile_data input is added, so no BUILD or lock edit is needed.
Tests call the actual shared status assembly and production success predicate. They do not execute the complete model-facing DynamicToolCall/Root authorization/response transport loop.

Final runtime retains original write-admission, unknown-status, READ and Committed/receipt predicate literally; new helper is an additional conjunct. Protected marker is present and no guard is moved out of its required source.

The existing real Session/App lifecycle calls the same production helper for REPLACE and STATUS. It asserts [true,true] for initial, recovered and repeated exact current goals; [false,false] after document drift and actual App readback loss. Outputs are saved under act2_model_tool_success_projection with complete_model_facing_handler_exercised=false. These are code assertions pending native execution, not executed results from static review.

The zero-capture local closure returns Copy [bool;2] arrays; repeated results are kept in a Vec and serialized at existing final artifact assembly. Existing effect/grant assertions are retained. The change adds no dispatch, grant or App lifecycle operation.

All 34 required literal markers across the three exact-base CALLERS protected_file entries for notes_thread_runtime.rs are present in the final source. This bounded literal check does not replace full caller scanner or required-function-order validation.
